original_idea.body: Hint-Acknowledgment Decay Across Hint Plausibility. Problem: hint-acknowledgment averages exist but how the rate varies with hint plausibility/authority is unknown. Direction: on a small open reasoning model and an MCQ set, inject the same hint under several plausibility-graded presentation styles, measure flip rate and CoT acknowledgment, plot acknowledgment vs plausibility to find a plausible-but-silent regime.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: mapping where authoritative hints stay unverbalized shows where CoT monitoring is blindest.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inherited cot-unfaithfulness harness + 7B model on single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused acknowledgment-vs-plausibility curve; building graded hint styles adds scope.

low_compute.reasoning: 7B reasoning model on single GPU, inference-only.

novelty.reasoning: Hint-acknowledgment averages published; the plausibility-graded dose-response may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Hint-unfaithfulness is studied; the hint-plausibility dose-response angle is plausibly open.
